verdict.rationale: Figma's core product docs explicitly describe multiplayer editing with live cursors, cursor chat, and shared real-time collaboration ('Work together in multiplayer files... talk to your teammates with cursor chat in one shared space' and 'together in real-time and in one place'), and community sentiment corroborates Figma's collaboration strength as a standout feature versus competitors. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report specifically testing simultaneous multi-editor sync/latency, and no deep technical detail on conflict resolution/CRDT sync mechanics.
